title: Underived supported sections as Hom
statement: Fix the finite coefficient setting $A$ of [def-pur-conventions]. For a closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] let $A_Z$ be the constant coefficient module and let $i_*$ be the underived direct image [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image]. There is an additive natural isomorphism $\Gamma_Z(X,-)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(i_*A_Z,-)$ on all sheaves of $A$-modules, where $\Gamma_Z$ is the kernel of restriction to the open complement [def-pur-support-cohomology]. No quasi-compactness assumption on the complement is required.

source.place: Milne, Lectures on Etale Cohomology, Section 9, proof of Theorem 9.4, p. 67; underived supported-Hom argument

proof.text: Apply the constant-coefficient cokernel presentation. Transport it through the canonical intrinsic realization equivalence, using its normalized rank-one and direct-image comparisons. This makes the fixed-scalar constant restriction the cokernel of the open constant counit.

The constant-sheaf adjunction and evaluation of a linear map at 1 identify Hom from the constant rank-one module with global sections. The open-extension adjunction gives the corresponding identification with sections over the complement. Naturality of the sheafification unit shows that precomposition by the open constant counit is restriction. The cokernel universal property therefore identifies Hom from the closed constant direct image with the kernel of restriction. This identification is additive and natural in the module sheaf. The comparison pullback preserves constant sheaves, so it identifies the coefficient object in the purity conventions with the fixed-scalar constant rank-one module.

theorem supported_sections_hom (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] :
    Nonempty ((supportSections i P.Coefficient ⋙
      forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ≅
        preadditiveCoyoneda.obj
          (op ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) i).obj (P.constant Z))))
